name: @swasthyasetu/contracts
comment: The wire format, defined ONCE. apps/api validates inbound requests with these schemas and apps/mobile builds outbound requests from the same types, so a field rename cannot drift between client and server - it becomes a typecheck failure in both. Zod is the only runtime dependency; it works on Hermes, so the mobile app can reuse these schemas offline. Relative imports must end in .ts (AGENTS.md section 3).
